guard.note: ins = le.getAttribute(attr), return if null; modifier(getUUIDFromString(name), name, factor, op); hasModifier -> removeModifier(uuid); addPermanentModifier(modifier); nothing else
a pure function of the name (kept per name)
hasModifier: a modifier with that UUID is held
removeModifier(UUID): removes the held modifier (from its operation set, the id map and the permanent set) and marks dirty
addPermanentModifier: add (operation set + id map, dirty) and record it permanent
getModifier(UUID): the id map read the check uses

l2hostility_trait_attribute_unchanged_sk.conversion: MixinExtras @ModifyExpressionValue on le.getAttribute(attr) (m_21051_) at the head of TraitManager.addAttribute (with the name, factor and operation arguments): null is answered (the method's own early return) when the instance already holds a permanent modifier with L2 Library's UUID for the name and the same name, amount bits and operation, so the remove + add pair that would leave the modifiers equal does not run; otherwise the instance and the method as shipped. Exact variant: no dirty mark for an unchanged re-apply. Runtime flag l2hostilityTraitAttributeUnchangedSkip. Helpers bons.furious.patch.l2hostility_coo49.L2TraitReapply + bons.furious.patch.attribute_lookup.AttributeReapply (method handle).
